content: Fastify's own .listen() defaults to binding the loopback interface (127.0.0.1/::1) when no host is specified -- this is a deliberate secure-by-default design in Fastify itself. Fleet should still pass host explicitly ('127.0.0.1') rather than relying on the implicit default, so the binding is self-documenting and immune to a future Fastify default change; verify with a startup smoke check that a connection from a non-loopback source is refused.
